excluded_attempts.reason: Excluded from performance medians: complete workflow conclusion was failure. The cache-disabled Playwright job timed out after 15 seconds waiting for the registration POST response in tests/account/mfa.spec.ts; 31 tests passed, 8 skipped, and 1 failed. Every other matrix job completed successfully.
Playwright failed the enable-TOTP test because the backup-code dialog was not visible within 5 seconds (31 passed, 1 failed, 8 skipped).

Excluded from accepted performance samples: baseline-1 cold-tool control, run 34690689946 attempt 3, workflow head 7bd81416aa2fd9239a00167a7d2e7f40a3c10bee.
The OpenAPI Generator 6.6.0 download returned HTTP 404 before the backend-utils unit tests could run. The workflow failed and its timing is not included in the performance comparison.

limitations: These are modeled source and matrix opportunities, not observed historical executable-cache hits; the proposed cache did not exist in these upstream runs.

A static closure resolved from the final implementation is projected backward. Historical dependency closures and per-job pruning are not replayed, and source-key survival does not prove equal historical resolution hashes.
Runner image, kernel, architecture, tools, environment, cache scope, retention, eviction, upload failures, and cache quotas are not modeled.
Only main push Test workflows present in the retained snapshot are modeled; pull-request and merge-group run behavior is not extrapolated.
Failed and cancelled workflows do not seed the model, even if an eligible job might have saved a cache before a later failure.
All jobs in one eligible workflow use the same source-epoch classification; intra-workflow producer-to-consumer availability is not credited.
A revert starts another epoch even if it restores an older reusable source key.

Job matrices differ: only 52 eligible workflows contain all three targets. Applying the overall warm fraction to full-matrix workflow wall-time measurements is not an observed or matrix-adjusted upstream saving.
Original daily API responses were not retained; the normalized original snapshot is hash-bound and every selected main row was matched to freshly retained raw API responses.

closure_derivation.workspace_pruning: Full source tree; historical pruning and historical closure changes are not replayed.

model.completion_aware_rule: A second projection additionally requires a preceding successful workflow producer to finish before the workflow starts (run counts) or before each target consumer starts (job counts). Producer completion is later than its cache-save step.
model.initial_state: No cache seed is assumed before the sample window.
model.invalidation_rule: A first-parent diff touching a closure-directory descendant, additional-directory descendant, or exact fixed file starts a new source epoch; renames are represented as delete plus add.
model.name: Static final-source path closure and historical successful main job matrices
model.run_rule: Sort main pushes by creation time. Exclude unsuccessful workflows. A successful workflow containing a target job seeds its source epoch. Its first eligible workflow is cold and later eligible workflows in the same epoch are warm.
